title: Admissions to the US Cadet Nurse Corps, 1943 to 1945
description: Bar chart, students. 36,000 students already in school joined when the Corps began; 50,827 were admitted in fiscal year 1944, 54,396 in fiscal 1945 and 28,220 in fiscal 1946, until admissions ended on 15 October 1945: 169,443 in all. Data: US Public Health Service, The United States Cadet Nurse Corps 1943–1948, 1950.
heading: CADET NURSE CORPS · ADMISSIONS
